# Shamsudin Aalam

> Shamsudin Aalam (also spelled Samsudin Alam) is a Software Developer specializing in Laravel & PHP, based in Kathmandu, Nepal. He builds production-grade REST APIs, enterprise web applications, and third-party integrations, and is currently learning Python and Django.

## About

- Role: Software Developer (Laravel & PHP)
- Experience: 3+ years
- Location: Kathmandu, Nepal
- Focus: Laravel web applications, REST API development, third-party API and payment gateway integration, deployment and DevOps, database design and optimization
- Skills: PHP, Laravel, REST API, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, GitLab CI/CD, Vue.js, Bootstrap, jQuery, AJAX, Ubuntu Linux, Nginx, Apache, DigitalOcean, Python and Django (currently learning)
